habitat: Broadleaved evergreen and semi-evergreen forest, wooded gardens and plantations; mid to upper canopy; sea level to 1800 m
description: Medium-sized leafbird, grass-green with a golden-orange forehead, black mask and throat, violet-blue chin and turquoise-blue shoulder patch (female duller, less blue); forages for insects, fruit and nectar in the forest canopy, often with a brush-tipped tongue; a fine mimic.
